name: Messiah Protocols
text: During the action phase, you may exhaust this card and spend any amount of influence to place 1 infantry from your reinforcements on a number of different planets you control equal to the influence spent.

name: Navigation Relays
text: After you activate a system, you may exhaust this card to allow your ships and units they transport to move out of systems that contain your command tokens during this tactical action.

name: Immortal II
text:
Cost 1(x2), Combat 7
 After this unit is destroyed or removed, capture this unit. DEPLOY: At the start of your turn, you may place 1 infantry on a planet you control.

name: Reality-Field Impactor
text: After you activate a system, you may choose 1 anomaly on the game board; that anomaly has no effect until the end of this tactical action.

name: Commando II
text: Units cannot use SPACE CANNON against this unit. After this unit is destroyed, place the unit on this card. At the start of your turn, place each unit that is on this card on planets that contain your space docks. 1(x2) 7;

name: Battlecruiser II
text:
Cost 2, Combat 6, Move 3, Capacity 1, AFB 5 (x2)
If the active system contains another player's units, this unit may move through systems that contain ships controlled by different other players.

name: Mirrorshard II
text:
Cost 2, Combat 6, Move 3, Capacity 1, Production 1
DEPLOY: During the agenda phase, after an outcome you voted for or predicted is resolved, place up to 1 cruiser in a system that contains your ships.

name: Modular Designs
text: Once during each of your actions, choose 1 of your units and 1 unit ability. That unit gains that unit ability with a value of 3, if applicable, until the end of that action.
notes: Not currently automated by the bot. Use Dicecord `/roll` and Async's `/add_sustain_damage` and `/modify_units` to mimic the desired unit abilities.

name: Consulate II
text:
PLANETARY SHIELD, SPACE CANNON 4
You may use this unit's SPACE CANNON against ships that are in adjacent systems. After another player activates this system, if you do not control this planet, capture up to 1 of their infantry on the game board.

name: Kaldur Arrest Field
text: When another player activates a system that contains 1 of your structures, you may capture 2 of their infantry on the game board, unless they spend 1 influence. You may spend your captured infantry as if they were trade goods.

name: Ravager II
text: After you win a space combat in this system, take up to 1 of your opponent's trade goods. 1, 7, 3, 1; ANTI-FIGHTER BARRAGE 5(x3)

name: Infiltration Networks
text: ACTION: Exhaust this card; for each planet that contains your coexisting units, you may destroy 1 infantry on that planet or take up to 2 trade goods or commodities from the player who controls that planet.

name: Astromantic Cloak
text:
Steel: Other players cannot look at your hand of action cards, promissory notes, or secret objectives. Other players cannot take or force you to give them your action cards, promissory notes, or secret objectives.

Star: After you commit units to a planet, you may choose for those units to coexist. When a player ends coexistence with your units on a planet, you may look at their hand of action cards, promissory notes, or secret objectives.

name: Astromantic Cloak (Steel)
text: Other players cannot look at your hand of action cards, promissory notes, or secret objectives. Other players cannot take or force you to give them your action cards, promissory notes, or secret objectives.

name: Astromantic Cloak (Star)
text: After you commit units to a planet, you may choose for those units to coexist. When a player ends coexistence with your units on a planet, you may look at their hand of action cards, promissory notes, or secret objectives.

name: Veiled Networking
text:
Steel: During the agenda phase, when an outcome would be resolved, if you voted for or predicted another outcome, you may spend 1 token from your strategy pool to discard the agenda instead; the agenda is resolved with no effect and it is not replaced.

Star: Your blockaded units can produce ships in adjacent systems that contain your command tokens and no other player's ships. Your units cannot lose their unit abilities or text abilities.

name: Veiled Networking (Steel)
text: During the agenda phase, when an outcome would be resolved, if you voted for or predicted another outcome, you may spend 1 token from your strategy pool to discard the agenda instead; the agenda is resolved with no effect and it is not replaced.

name: Veiled Networking (Star)
text: Your blockaded units can produce ships in adjacent systems that contain your command tokens and no other player's ships. Your units cannot lose their unit abilities or text abilities.

name: Synchrony Matrix
text: At any time, you may exhaust this card to ready 1 non-technology component other than a strategy card in your play area.

name: Wyvern II
text: You may commit this unit to a planet as if it were a ground force. When combat ends, return it to the space area. Fighters in excess of your ships' capacity count against your fleet pool. 1(x2), 8, 2; ANTI-FIGHTER BARRAGE 9(x2)

name: Emergency Modifications
text: After a player activates a system, choose 1 unit on the game board; apply +2 to that unit's Capacity value, if it has one, until the end of this tactical action.
notes: Not currently able to be automated.

name: V.I.R. Training
text: During each round of combat, you may cancel 1 hit your units produced to cancel up to 1 hit your opponent's units produced. At any time, you may exhaust this card to cancel 1 hit produced against your units.

name: Âtman-Weave Supressors
text: At the end of a round of ground combat, if your units participating in that combat did not stop coexisting during this action, you may exhaust this card to have each of those units enter coexistence. That combat ends in a draw.

name: RAM-Gate System
text:
Up to 1 ship in each system that contains 1 of your command tokens does not count against your fleet pool.

Your command tokens in systems that contain your ships have a capacity value of 2 as if they were your units.

name: Ecological Engineering
text:
The minimum resource and influence values of each planet you control are 1 instead of 0.

Planets you control that have technology specialties have PLANETARY SHIELD as if they were units.

name: Near-Field Cloaking
text: When you win a combat you may either exhaust this card to take one of your opponent's action cards, at random, or ready this card.

name: Viral Entanglement
text:
Before you resolve the secondary ability of a strategy card, you may exhaust this card and spend 1 token from your strategy pool and destroy 2 of oyur infantry on the game board to resolve the secondary ability of another strategy card instead.

You cannot resolve the primary ability of a strategy card during this ability.

name: Fractal Spike Drives
text: Units your ships transport can be moved out of systems that contain your command tokens. You may treat wormholes as ingress tokens or gravity rifts.

name: Networked Constructors
text: Your command tokens in systems have PRODUCTION 1 as if they were your units. After a player activates a system, you may exhaust this card to place 1 structure from your reinforcements on a planet you control in that system.

name: Stasis Field Generators
text:
Hits you produce with unit abilities cannot be canceled. Capture units destroyed by your unit abilities.

After you roll a combat or ability die you may return 1 of your captured units to apply +1 to the result.

name: Daxcive Animators
text:
At the start of a ground combat you are participating in, you may exhaust this card to place 1 infantry on that planet.
After you gain a technology or win a ground combat, ready this card.

name: Gravity Drive
text: After you activate a system, you may exhaust this card to apply +1 to the move value of 1 of your ships during this tactical action.

name: Graviton Laser System
text: After 1 or more of your units make a SPACE CANNON roll, you may exhaust this card; if you do, hits produced by that roll must be assigned to non-fighter, non-infantry units, if able.

name: Self Assembly Routines
text:
After you produce 1 or more units in a system, you may place 1 mech from your reinforcements in that system.
After 1 of your mechs is destroyed during ground combat, you may gain 1 trade good or exhaust this card to produce 1 hit against your opponent’s units.

name: Bioplasmosis
text: At the end of your turn, you may move up to 2 infantry from any planet you control to a planet you control in the same or an adjacent system.

name: Production Biomes
text:
Apply +2 to the PRODUCTION value of each of your units with PRODUCTION.
When 1 or more of your units use PRODUCTION, you may spend 1 command token from your command sheet to gain 4 trade goods and choose another player to gain 2 trade goods.

name: Spatial Conduit Cyclinder
text: During tactical actions in systems that contain your units and no other player's units, you may treat the active system as adjacent to all other systems that contain 1 or more of your units.

name: Executive Order
text: ACTION: Exhaust this card to draw and reveal the top or bottom card of the agenda deck. Then, players vote on that agenda as if you were the speaker; you vote first on that agenda.

name: Inheritance Systems
text: You may exhaust this card when you research a technology to ignore all of that technology's prerequisites, or gain 1 command token.

name: L4 Disruptors
text:
During invasion, other players cannot use SPACE CANNON against your units.
During the action phase, you may exhaust this card to repair each of your units on the game board.

name: Lazax Gate Folding
text:
During your tactical actions, treat systems that contain legendary planets you do not control as if they contain both an alpha and beta wormhole.
When you pass, place 2 infantry from your reinforcements into coexistence on Mecatol Rex, if able.
